items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: Now if I’d played it like Ornette Coleman might have played it, yeah, you could say that

ctx.x: I understand that group, if I’m correct, auditioned to be on the Ted Mack Amateur Hour?

Yeah, we did. That was the day that Kennedy got killed, man. We were on the way to Jacksonville and they said our version of “Blue Moon” it was too jazzy. But nobody was in a good mood but it went too jazzy, our “Blue Moon” was going to be too jazzy. Now if I’d played it like Ornette Coleman might have played it, yeah, you could say that, but it was danceable you know. But nobody was in a good mood but I don’t think they was going to give it to nobody black during that time you know, in Jacksonville, Florida. But…
It was a little too out for them I suppose, at the time.
